Backend: 75/75 pytest pass (test_iter78_admin_moderation 9, test_iter79_activation_flow 9, test_iter80_password_reset 9, test_iter82_per_base_symbol_resolution 13, test_iter83_account_uniqueness_guard 5, test_iter84_pairing_flow 11, test_iter85_ea_token_autoload 13, test_iter86_test_trade 6). Frontend (Playwright on public preview URL): Login → admin@trading.bot/admin123 → 200 cookie set, dashboard renders. /accounts: ADD ACCOUNT button + DOWNLOAD EA v1.36 link both present; 5 FORCE TRADE buttons rendered with correct testid pattern force-test-trade-<account_number> (Start Trader/OnEquity/Tauro/VTMarkets/RoboForex — paper Kraken excluded). Clicked first FORCE TRADE → window.confirm shown ('Fire a small test trade…') → accepted → POST /api/accounts/{id}/test-trade returned 200 {ok:true, trade_id:6a438d3e61fa610aae31f6ec, symbol:XAUUSD, lot_size:0.01}. /terms renders 14KB markdown with 0 inline <script> in content area (DOMPurify defense verified). /forgot-password renders email input. /verify-email?token=invalid shows 'Activation failed' inline. /reset-password?token=x renders two password inputs. /admin/users renders user list (60+ users), per-row SUSPEND + TERMINATE buttons visible.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor naming-discrepancy: review request spec calls for suspend-user-<id> / terminate-user-<id> testids on AdminUsers.jsx, but the actual implementation uses btn-suspend-<id> / btn-terminate-<id>. Buttons render and function correctly; consider aligning naming for spec consistency or update the spec.

Accounts.jsx: spec mentions a TEST button testid prefix test-account-<id>, but selector matched 0 elements. The TEST button is visually rendered (verified in screenshot between COPY and FORCE TRADE) so functionality is fine — likely the testid uses a different prefix (e.g., test-trade-<id>). Recommend adding the documented data-testid pattern to keep automated tests stable.
FORCE TRADE confirm uses native window.confirm() — works but is not a shadcn dialog, so it bypasses the app theme. For UX consistency consider switching to AlertDialog like other destructive actions.
/api/test-trade response message is verbose multi-line; consider a structured payload (trade_id + status) and let UI build the human string from i18n for easier toast layout.
